title: Environmental Impact Assessment of Natural Resource Projects

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, objectives, and importance of environmental impact assessment for natural resource projects.
Understand Vietnam's policies and legal framework for environmental impact assessment of natural resource projects.
Understand various methods used for evaluating environmental impacts of natural resource projects.
Understand the role of community involvement in environmental impact assessments of natural resource projects.
Analyze and determine environmental impacts of natural resource projects using various evaluation methods.
Apply project management principles to conduct environmental impact assessments of natural resource projects.
Develop critical thinking skills to assess and evaluate environmental impacts of natural resource projects.
Work collaboratively in teams to solve problems related to environmental impact assessments of natural resource projects.
